proposals.title: Human Right to Water
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's due diligence process to identify and address risks related to the Human Right to Water across its operations and value chain.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because Chevron has in place policies and processes to identify and manage human rights risks and promote responsible management of water resources.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding report on reducing carbon footprint
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on how Chevron can reduce its carbon footprint in alignment with Paris Agreement greenhouse gas reductions, including low-carbon investment and reduced oil and gas investment.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because preparing the report requested is an unnecessary and inefficient use of Chevron's resources

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding board committee on climate change
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board charter a new Board Committee on Climate Change to oversee corporate strategy and responses to climate-related risks and opportunities.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal as the full Board already has oversight of the Company's strategy, including the Company's response to climate change

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding independent chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board adopt a policy requiring the Chair of the Board, whenever possible, to be an independent director.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because the Board believes that stockholder interests are best served when Directors have the flexibility to determine the best person to serve as Chairman

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding special meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaws be amended to give holders of 10% of outstanding common stock the power to call a special shareowners meeting.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because stockholders have consistently supported Chevron's current By-Law regarding special meetings
